summary: All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. Performance on most pages has stabilized or improved since yesterday's TBT spike, though /, /projects/note-structurer, and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue remain below the 85-point threshold and warrant continued monitoring.

About page with dark header, 'About Me' hero, animated code-block panel showing the developer object, stat counters (12+, 16+, 2, 7), an Engineering Culture section with particle animation, and a full-width contact form at the footer, all rendering cleanly on desktop and mobile.

Clinical Note Structurer project page with a green 'Evals: 10/10 passing' badge, two-column visit-note / structured-result demo panel, synthetic-sample buttons, an amber disclaimer banner, and expandable JSON / architecture accordion sections, all clean on desktop and mobile.
